headline: A massive gain for the Chiefs!
what_happened: P.Mahomes threw a deep pass to T.Thornton, who caught it and ran all the way to the one-yard line for a huge gain.
who: P.Mahomes and T.Thornton are the key players.
why_it_matters: Since the Chiefs were on third down, this successful play gives them a fresh set of four tries and puts them right at the goal line. This is great news for your team, as it boosts their chances of winning significantly.
